summary.headline: Chapters on War and Inceptions
summary.text: Continuation of a chapter-title inventory for unnamed astrological collections, covering military expeditions and war inceptions, sieges and cities, kings and magistrates, letters, seasonal and solar transitions, and various inceptions attributed to Theophilus, Zoroaster, Julian of Laodicea, and Orpheus. Cross-references cite Vatican, Paris, Italian, Vindobon, and other codices, as well as Palchus and the Catalogus entries.
